text: だいじに　つかってね！

patterns.name: 〜てください
patterns.explanation: A て-form verb left on its own is a casual request, a short form of てください; ね softens it. つかってね = 'use it, okay?'.

patterns.name: 〜に (in what way)
patterns.span: だいじに　つかって
patterns.explanation: に after a quality word turns it into the way something is done. だいじに　つかって = 'use it carefully'.
